formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x3 : List (Option (Fin x1))) (x4 : List ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x2 → (∀ x6 ∈ x4, x3[x6]? = Option.some Option.none) → (∃ (x7 : Fin x1 → Bool) (x8 : Fin x1 → Bool), x2.eval (List.map (fun (x9 : Option (Fin x1)) => x9.elim Bool.false x7) x3) ≠ x2.eval (List.map (fun (x9 : Option (Fin x1)) => x9.elim Bool.false x8) x3)) → ∃ (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x8 ∧ x8.size + (List.filter (fun (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => x4.any fun (x10 : ℕ) => (if x9.op.eval [Bool.false] = Bool.true then List.take (1 : ℕ) x9.inputs else x9.inputs).contains x10) x2.gates).length ≤ x2.size ∧ ∀ (x9 : Fin x1 → Bool), x8.eval (List.ofFn x9) = x2.eval (List.map (fun (x10 : Option (Fin x1)) => x10.elim Bool.false x9) x3)
plain_statement: For an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit whose inputs are fed, position by position, either one of n variables or the constant false, and any list of positions fed false: if the fed function is not constant, some fan-in-two circuit on the n variables computes it with at least as many gates fewer as there are gates reading those positions (a NOT counted only at its first input).
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_3) computes its edge function
